text:
Cute, cozy, clean place to get some delicious dumplings. Been here many times but haven't ever tried the chicken curry because I'm just too in love with the dumplings. If you're really hungry get the order and a half, and don't forget to try the dipping sauce!

(The pork buns are also good but I believe they're just steamed from frozen.)
The food and hospitality is a 10/10!!! Their dumplings are way better than Chicago ( I say this as a native) & remind me of NYC dumplings. So much flavor and crisp!! I highly recommend eating here!!
These are dollar dumplings drenched in soy sauce. Exactly what you expect, but nothing fresh or flavorful here. Good snack at a decent price.
It’s not a traditional Chinese restaurant. It’s a hole in the wall serving delicious fried dumplings and chicken curry.
Really incredible for the price. We got pork dumplings and cold peanut noodles. Very fast too.

The food here is so good and the service is very fast. It’s in the perfect spot to walk to the corner and grab lunch if you work at UVA. The chicken curry combo comes with dumplings and a bun and is a great deal. The dumplings are perfection!
Maybe it's a coincidence, but a few hours after consuming the food there I ended up having stomach problems.
The hot buns are amazing! So is the dumplings but them hot buns!
Delicious food with big portions and fast service at a great price. Great atmosphere too.
It's a great place, some of the staff can be indifferent, it's best to go when the ladies are working because they don't re-fry old dumplings and serve them.
Location is kind of a hole in the wall type place but very well kept. Dumplings are great and cheap. The staff are always quick and polite.

The absolute best dumplings I have ever had and I have traveled around the world to many countries and lived in cities with great Asian cuisine. Nothing compares to the dumplings at Marco & Luca! The dumplings burst with flavor and the sauce is delicious and perfect. I dream of them! You can really tell each one is handmade with love!
This place gets a 6/10. Food flavor/quality has definitely gone down over the years 🥲 A good snack though!
I have loved these dumplings since I used to buy them from a side alley on the downtown mall (long since gone location, maybe the original ??).
Small place , doesn’t look like much but the food is excellent, if you like dumplings you have to stop and try these
It was the best place to eat when I was a student and it's still the best place to eat now!
Delicious and well-priced dumplings.
We had the fried pork dumplings. This place is pretty busy when we came. The dumplings were pretty good but doesn't taste like Chinese dumplings but they still tasted decent.

Having traveled through China made me see that this has nothing to do with Chinese food. The meat inside seams processed and the dumplings are pretty certainly frozen. So cheap meat with cheap dumplings and the sauce is just a random soy sauce.
The food is goddamn amazing! The fried pork dumplings are the best!!! Get the 10pc, trust me!! The decor is so cute and cozy, and the two ladies working there are the sweetest !
Eh, ordered steamed dumplings, a pork bun and cold sesame noodles. Nothing by was great and didn’t even feel like finishing the noodles

Found this little shop in the downtown mall and got the chicken curry combo. It comes with their chicken curry on white rice with a steamed bun, fried dumplings, and a canned drink. The curry flavor was rich and not too spicy with plenty of chicken and vegetables in it. Great with the fluffy rice. The steamed bun was okay. The fried dumplings were tasty with a nice crunch.
Service was quick and the place has a good vibe to it.
For $15, it was plenty of food and I was happy with my meal.
I loveee the chicken curry combo
Best dumplings ever
Great wonton soup!

On two separate occasions recently, I found chunks of pork/ pork tendons in the vegetarian bun. I’m not vegetarian, but I can’t eat pork, so it was very disappointing that there was pork in the vegetarian dish. Otherwise there was OK service.
Food was amazing. They even fulfilled a special request.

Limited menu, vegan available
Fried dumplings are good
Good dumplings and soup but ordered takeout and they left half my dumplings out of the bag.
Sat outside and enjoyed a wonderful soup and snack. Great to try!
Good food, very friendly staff, functioning WiFi, Clean and calm to sit down for a meal. The sauce on dumplings is very tasty and the portion/price is great!
Love their dumplings. Always great service and very kind. Highly recommend
The dumplings are pretty good, however the buns are a bit overpriced.
Best dumplings I have ever had..
One of my favorite lunch spots as I come here at least once a week for the chicken curry combo!  Friendly staff and good food!
Best dumplings I’ve ever had

Really not worth the time/ money. Rice was way over cooked and under seasoned. Bao bun was obviously made with pre made dough. Filling was gross. The chicken curry was bland and the dumplings tasted store bought. There are so many great places around here that I would recommend (like got dumplings if you want dumplings). I really don't know why Marco and Luca have so many stars...
SO GOOD
This is my favorite of the Marco & Luca's locations. Beautiful decor and a smiling staff. The best hot & sour soup in Charlottesville.. just needs more hot & sour!
We always stop by Marco & Luca when we are in Charlottesville. We enjoy the dumplings and noodles. Cosy place with a limited menu.

WISH there were more options. People working who I’ve interacted with are sometimes a little bit brusque. If you’re vegetarian don’t even bother just go somewhere else, last time I went there weren’t veggie options. If you like decent pork dumplings I definitely would recommend though. Some people like it better than got dumplings down the street, some would say skip on Marco & Luca for got dumplings. Neither are bad though!
We love their dumplings in the staff is always friendly and the prices are very cheap.

**Copied and pasted from their other location.**
___________________________________________

It's a local favorite, for too many reasons to list!

The dumplings are the best I've ever had. All the time, every time, for a decade. I've never even heard of one single dumpling being sub par and I've been eating there since before this location existed.

The location is just as good. You can sit at the window and watch the downtown mall stroll by, or you can sit at one of the cozy interior tables for a more private and less distracting experience. It's relatively small, but they make great use of the space. I think they also added a whole second dining room to keep up! Always very clean and we'll decorated.

Prices are unreasonably low. Years ago I was shocked to see they raised the price, after some math I realized they hadn't even kept up with inflation. It was my #1 choice on the mall when I had no money, and it's still my number one choice when I do.

But, the people are the best part. Polite, friendly, personable, and provide services far beyond expectations. Always with a smile. They work on holidays, and even organized a field trip to teach my whole (2nd grade?) class how to make our own pasta and do calligraphy! They really do a fantastic job and show us all what a local business should be like.

I'm glad to see they are still here doing well, and even expanding! Charlottesville's downtown mall wouldn't be the same without them! They really are a fantastic part of making our local community what it should be!
Dumplings

They are always so sweet and friendly every time I go in. The food is amazing and the good quality has stayed consistent even with several locations now. Very inexpensive for very good food. One of the few restaurants that doesn't overcharge. Most restaurants do it out of greed and claim that it's due to inflation. Marco and Luca's show that there are still some businesses with integrity.
The chicken curry combo with a steam bun and dumplings is delicious. Food was served quick and staff were very friendly. One of the highest quality, best deals on the DT mall!
Great little dumplings for a snack
We visit from Staunton at least once a month for the vegetable steamed buns. The staff is also wonderful. Would highly recommend:)

Myself and my friends and family love this place and the food is excellent!
Frequent visitor for many years.
This was a pleasant treat. The dumplings were really good and just enough, noodle salad was also good definitely would recommend especially if you like dumplings.

Fried dumplings (or get them steamed) and sweet and spicy noodles are both top notch, as is the wonton soup. Skip the expensive restaurants down the street and get yourself in here. The only thing we tried that was fine but not great was the buns.
INSANE
Inexpensive quick In-N-Out perfect for college student
Great place for a super tasty, quick, no hassle meal.
Very nice workers and delicious food
Great dumplings!
Great dumplings and wontons!! Evrything is great there!
So good so yummy!! Best place to get dumplings. The fried dumplings are so good!! And the workers are so kinds to me everytime I go 🩷🩷🩷
Excellent food at an affordable price.

Some of the best dumplings I've ever had.  Visiting from out of state, reasonable priced. Cold noodles are amazing as well. not a huge meal, definitely a lite lunch. PAY ATTENTION TO THE SAUCE. if youre getting takeout, get the sauce on the side. sauce will spill everywhere.  Will be returning probably more than once before we leave next week.
Good steamed pork dumplings
Try this place if you get a chance! Food is delicious, quick, and authentic. New fave!

The dumplings were good, but I felt like we were not welcome to eat there. We only got utensils for one person when there were clearly two of us. It really seemed like we were an inconvenience. It’s not somewhere I’d go out of my way to visit but if I’m around and need a snack I’d swing by for dumplings, but definitely get them to go.
Great dumplings and the food came quick!! Friendly staff , what a great local place!
Dumpling, bao, wonton are just ok. Skin are thick, filling is so so. Like dimsum place items much better
Absolutely perfect dumplings and really generous on the prices. Highly recommend going here.
Ausgezeichnet
Place is awesome

Everything we tried was so delicious and fresh, not to mention inexpensive! Ive never had hot and sour or wonton soup that seemed so deliciously made from scratch. The music playing in the cafe was uplifting and refreshing and the staff was helpful and happy. This is the only place I visited twice while in Charlottesville and I guarantee I'll be back.

Enjoyed the BEST wonton soup I've ever had. Teens devoured dumplings and chicken & curry.

Fair prices and very nice staff. Enjoyed sitting at the window counter and people watching.
Marco and Luca’s is a classic. When my daughter and I needed lunch in Charlottesville this is the first place she requested!
價格很便宜，味道也還算可以，有點拉美的感覺。
Delicious, fast, and great value.
This place has been here for decades! I stop by everytime I’m in the area. I love the sauce and a cheap snack!

I'm always on the search for dumplings, so seeing this local chain caught my attention. With a limited menu, I had high hopes that they'd hit on all items. While the flavors were decent, I'm relatively sure this is pretty standard frozen steam buns and dumplings from an Asian market marked up quite a lot.

The dumplings seem extremely similar to the Way Fong frozen dumplings (probably my favorite brand of frozen dumplings), except they're deep fried and covered with a lot of sauce. The sauce and dumplings aren't bad, but the sauce overpowers the nice flavor of the dumplings.

The steam buns are fine, but I think they're reheating them in a microwave. What happens is the dough gets really tough/chewy within a minute or so once it's out of the microwave.

If you like the dumplings, check out Way Fong frozen dumplings.
Soooo delicious!!

The food is 5 star but I have to give 3 for now. I was craving their dumplings soooo badly and saw that they were open til 3. I got there at 11 last night which was a Friday and the sign on the door says open til 2:30 a.m. but they were CLOSED. Hurt my heart! Hopefully they dont usually close earlier than the sign says or maybe it had something to do with the fact that around the corner was another one (relocating?).
Fantastic food! I am a huge fan of dumplings and steam buns so this place it like a dream! Dragana was very sweet and helpful. I will be stopping by this spot everytime I am in Charlottesville.
Everything tastes good when you are drunk, especially dumplings! ;) The unique feature of this place is that it's open till 2 am.
Dumplings and hot and sour soup are my favorites. Limited menu but what they do they do very well.
Best late night food in cville. Get dumplings, buns and cold noodles. You will be glad you did.
A quaint shop.  Cheap but decent food.
They're not open. Google says they're open until 3am, but that's hours away and they're closed. Beware of the hours they post... not likely to be open.
Amazing dumplings, amazing hot and sour soup.
Simple menu, all good

It was truly a happy day when Marco and Luca decided to open a restaurant on the Corner.  The dumplings have been a Charlottesville staple and incredibly cheap, and them opening closer to Grounds made it all the better.  A perfect quick bite for any time if the day or night.
Love the wonton soup. The dumplings are good to.

I really do love the food here but every single time I have been here, the lady at the front gives us attitude and despite asking for two orders, she puts our order in one plate and bin - making it super inconvenient to eat and also very weird for friends who are stopping by for lunch. When I asked for an extra fork (because she only gave us one to share), she said no.
Fried veggie dumplings and hot and sour soup are fantastic.  Also inexpensive, great place.

Fabulous place to stop in for delicious fried dumplings and stuffed pork buns in the heart of the downtown Charlottesville.

Located conveniently across from a coffee shop too.
Great food and great prices! They are always nice
extremely good prices for good food. the service was not the best but the price made it very worth it.

A long time favorite in Charlottesville, the price has gone up over the years but still a delicious way to fill up for not much money. The fried dumplings are average, mass produced frozen dumplings. They are cooked and the fried to achieve that perfect crispiness. The sauce is the star. It is a combination of soy sauce, hoisin sauce and hot sauce. I have never been able to replicate it at home

Ordered 1 portion of the 7 piece friend dumplings and 1 drink (vit kit) for just under $10. Doable for a quick cheap eat.
The soy sauce was also good, I do wish it was a little spicier.
Can’t speak for any other items since I didn’t taste my colleagues food but they mentioned the bun wasn’t anything to rave for.
Delicious dumplings and noodles! Quick service and veggie options too!
Some of the best dumplings I’ve ever had. Used to go here regularly when working on the downtown mall. Worth the stop, delicious and affordable.
Excellent place to eat dumplings. Not only do they taste fantastic but they also don't cost too much. The employee also gave us two servings for free, unexpectedly.
Cheap and a little greasy.  Tasty dumplings for when you want a quick snack. Popular with students
quiet on a Sunday evening, freshly-prepared dumplings at a reasonable price! takes cards now, but prices don't include tax, neither of which is mentioned on their Facebook page.
Great dumplings!

This is just what I remembered from graduate school, only this one is closer to campus.  They still don't take plastic and everything is served in styrofoam.  The prices are about the same as before despite the recession.  The decor is literally that of someone's kitchen with a cash-only register.  Felt like a new-age lemonade stand - for dumplings.
If you're looking for dumplings in Charlottesville, this little restaurant has got you covered. Although it is often packed, it is well worth it for these amazing, reasonably priced treasures
Amazingly delicious.
Awesome dumplings
A great little restaurant that serves amazing dumplings for cheap.  If you haven't been in a while, they've also started to accept credit/debit cards.
Food is excellent, fast, and on the cheap side. Highly recommend.
Reasonable prices and amazing dumplings
Reminds me of my college days. Quick and cheap lunch.
It has been well over 10 years since I've had these dumplings. I've lived in Texas since late 2015 and I've yet to find anything remotely close to this treat.
Great and very good, the sesame noodles are really delicious
It does not taste like Chinese food.
Very cozy and cute, had an amazing date here. The staff were super nice and welcoming.

Disappointed.  It had been a while since Ive been here, but I had a craving for Pan Fried Dumplings.  First thing I saw when i walked in was Pan Fried Dumplings written in big letters on the sign above the counter.  While tasty they were not PFD.  They were breaded and deep fried.

Charming place on the mall. Small menu. Fried veggie dumplings are cooked well and have a good sauce. Definitely not diet friendly though. The soup is good+. Pass on the veggie stickie bun. Good, prompt service. Annoying Add Tip register.
It’s ok for the price. I wouldn’t seek it out but I’d go there if I was in the neighborhood and everything else was closed 🤷🏽‍♂️
Food looked good, but very rude. Yelled at us to move the line to block the door, instead of us trying to be out of the way.
Been going here for over 10 years!

This dumplings shop is a hidden gem that deserves recognition. If you're a dumpling enthusiast or just someone looking for an unique dining experience, you won't be disappointed; you'll be coming back for more!

We on a whim stopped in to try some dumplings while visiting Charlottesville for a recent bach trip. These dumplings were so good! Also reasonably priced. Definitely stop in and try the pork dumplings if you get a chance!
Dumplings are great - buns tasted reheated in a microwave.
Awesome dumplings at Marco and Luca!  The store on route 29 is something else, plenty of quirky and weird items decorate the inside.  Great food and great service.
Good quick food. Not the biggest selection of food with meat. But overall pretty tasty.
Small shop with very low prices for excellent food. Tastes amazing
Delicious quick snack... Loved the sweet sauce on the dumplings
The absolute best dumplings anywhere!
Nice, Hot and fresh dumplings. They we’re so good we forgot to take a picture.

This was a neat little restaurant and cheep too. We ordered both noodles options and both steam buns. It didn't quite make a full meal but together it was under 10 bucks for dinner. You truly can't beat it for the price
The service was fast and the food delicious!
Amazing food at a great price.

So good!!! Highly recommend! I got the hot pork bun and the chicken curry.

I am a lover of both buns and curry, and this place smacked! Haha, legit the boss man hooked me up. I got my curry and one bun and it was so good that when I left, I had to get 2 more. Didn’t even know it at the time but he had given me 3 for the price of 2.

Very fast service too! I ordered, got my Pepsi out of the fridge, found an empty table and he was already calling me for my food.

Loved this place, will be back again if I’m in the area. You should go.

Fried dumplings was good. Soy sauce very strong and creamy.
We tried the pork bao which had soy sauce on it which was weird. It’s not very good either.
Friendly staff, good food, and my first experience with this restaurant. I must say it was a great experience and I recommend you give it a try.

SO GOOD! and so cheap too :) the man at the front was super friendly and gave me an extra dumpling. the food was quick to come out but so delicious. the sauce really makes the dish. definitely am coming back
We very much enjoyed the pork dumplings and noodles with peanut oil, sesame oil & cucumber. We look forward to returning!
Absolute gem. Great hotbuns!
Stopped in for a small lunch, it was delicious and we thoroughly enjoyed the experience!
I've been going since they opened and the whole experience has always been great.  I try to make it here every time I'm in the area.
The dumplings and the boa buns are top notch.
Dank
A bunch of vegetarian options. The sweet and sour noodles was delicious and fresh.
always so yummy!
Decent dumpling shop. Good pork buns. Especially for the price. Probably they only place on the Downtown Mall where you can get a whole meal for $6.
Quick and easy. Pork buns were delicious!

Gaaaaahd, this place is so gooooooood. The dumplings are number one, followed by the cold noodles, and pork buns coming in at a very close third. My family and I have eaten here a couple times. It is our go-to lunch spot when visiting Charlottesville. 😋
Absolutely amazing. Definitely a must stop. This place will now be a staple in our C'ville trips. I can't recommend this place enough. The staff was super friendly and willing to have a quick chat.
Iconic!!! The dumplings ARE dynamite (AND crispy!!!) and the sesame noodles are ALWAYS refreshing 😌 Very friendly staff too :) Another college student friendly place as well!!
Nice spot in the mall.
Kind & Caring Owners, Friendly Staff, and for over 15 years the BEST Fried Dumplings with an amazing sauce!
The only dumplings I like as much as my own

The pork buns were absolutely delicious, but I'm bias because they are one of my favorite foods. The dumplings were great also, but I wish they were pan fried instead of deep fried. The price was good for the amount of food we got.
Good affordable food from good ppl. Wunderbar! 👍🏻
Best dumblings around and for such a reasonable price!!
We love this place! Sesame noodles and dumplings are amazing!
Great dumplings and the sauce the give you with the dumplings is very good!

went to a quick cville trip! get the chicken curry combo for only $12 with 6 fried dumplings + steamed bun. definitely loved how yummy the food is! the server is also nice :) i would definitely come back soon.

My boyfriend and I were in town for a show and wanted a quick bite before going to it. We both got an order of 6 pork dumplings…and it was honestly our favorite meal out of everything we had in Charlottesville. We dined in and were served our dumplings quickly. They were delicious and super crispy, which I think added to the experience. Marco and Luca soy sauce is really yummy - it has the saltiness and flavor of soy sauce while also being thicker and having a sweet, savory taste that pairs wonderfully with the dumplings. If we had more time, we absolutely would’ve gone back for more dumplings!
Good place to stop in for a quick bite. Very affordable for the quality of food. The pork dumplings are very good. Quick service. I also recommend the pork bun.

I've always loved this place. Best dumplings in the entire city (and maybe that I've ever had) and the staff have always been friendly and helpful. I was very happy when they opened a second spot on The Corner.
dumplin

It's a Tasty Treat

FOOD

Simple, but good. It's one of those foods that has everything you want in a simple cheap dish.

It will definitely fill you up. But, in my opinion, it's something that I would not eat too often.

Yet, I have to restate it was good and the price was fair.

I have to return to taste other items.

We had the mini fried dumplings and pork bread.

Not too salty unless you add the soy sauce.

CUSTOMER SERVICE

Was awesome! Greated us with a smile and with an inviting smile!

BATHROOMS

Very Clean.

RETURN FACTOR
100%

RECOMMEND A FRIEND FACTOR
100% for me it's a novelty type of food.
Amazing food! Dumplings, baos, and cold noodles are GREAT! The pork dumplings are a must!
Dumplings were delicious. Best dumplings ever. Food was ready right away. Great prices. Great customer service. Warm seating area. Will be coming again.

Grabbed some dumplings and pork hot buns at night. Food was ready on time and hot! The fried dumplings were pretty good and drenched in their soy sauce. Really love their sauce!! The pork buns were good too. Great food especially for the price! Definitely stop by for some dumplings!
The noodles are really good if you havent tasted the original ones. Dunplings are awesome.
I live in NC and if I'm driving anywhere near here I make sure and go to eat some pork buns.
Very nice that they have vegetable dumplings for vegetarians.
This place is epic.
You've got to try the dumplings, we had both the pork and the vegetarian dumplings and loved them both. Indoor and outdoor seating are available.
Great services and tasty dumplings!! Definitely would recommend :)
i got the spicy. my daughter got the sweet. i ate all of mine and she ate half of hers and still neither of us are sure we liked it so we probably go back and get it again so we can be sure.

Best dumplings in town!! Would definitely recommend. The servers are nice. The sauce is out of this world. The dumplings are perfect. Me and my friends go there a lot, and we have a great time. Thank you for making the best snack
AMAZING DUMPLINGS
Amazing So DELICIOUS I cannot get enough of the SOYSAUCE there 😋!

I just came in from DC and I am Chinese... I just want to say that this is one of the best dumpling places I have ever had. The dumpling sauce... amazing. The dumplings... amazing. The cold peanut noodles... also amazing and the buns are just wow!
I absolutely love Marco & Luca's! I try to stop by at least once a week, the food is great, the price is affordable, and the people who work there are super friendly! 10/10
Amazing Dumplings! Definitely worth the drive from Lynchburg.
Fantastic dumplings and pork buns! Will be my first stop in Charlottesville from now on!
This is awesome! Definitely recommend the pork bun. And the soda is super cheap!

The proprietoress is so kind and the food is super fresh and good.
For a refreshing summer treat, the cold noodles are a must!
We love this place 🥰
What can you say no other option for fresh dumplings  that can compare!  wouldn’t change a thing!
dumplings are superb but sauce is even better. Family owned business. Owners are really nice people who love their customers and their job.
Delicious dumplings and sesame noodles
Great dumplings and friendly service!
Absolutely amazing!

I haven't been to this place after graduating from the school. Nostalgic and wondering if they have the same taste as before we went. As per usual ordered sesame noodle and the dumplings. They still got it and sauces are still awesome. I am sure other alumni who misses this place will come back and won't regret. Enjoy it and try them again if you are in town. =)

Small menu which meant that had to try everything. Everything was delicious. By far some of the best dumplings in the area. Curry was great also. The pork buns were good but I would not order them again. Got 2 more orders of dumplings to go. They are that good!
A local fav, friendly staff and good food, usually get the dumplings, hot sour soup and noodles
Great dumplings!

Such a great spot to stop at Downtown! I usually get an order of dumplings, their equally popular sesame noodles and the hot and sour soup (super filled with tofu and other yummies and LOVE the flavor - thanks to a nice amount of white pepper). Also love the patio seating!
These are the best dumplings I have ever had.
Quick and delicious! Chicken curry combo is awesome.
Ordered the dumplings, sesame noodles and pork buns. The food was delicious but overpriced. Dumplings were very crispy and flavorful. Great decor, ambience, and service.
yummy yummy dinpli mg taste good mmmmmmmm didnt usebathroom
Fast service, great prices, decent dumplings. Unimpressive pork bun and cold noodle dish.
Delicious little local spot with a small menu that they do an AMAZING job at preparing!! Everything is YUMMY!!!
This place is INCREDIBLE! From order to table took about 30 seconds, and everything was hot and fresh!

This had great reviews on Google so my brother, sister-in-law, and I stopped here. Prices are wonderful but the food was not our favorite.
If you're on a budget and want something quick this is your place and they do have seating inside which is nice on a rainy or chilly day.

I'm not a dumpling or hot bun connoisseur so these may be some of the better and more authentic ones, I don't know. I do know that personally my brother and sister-in-law and I did not prefer the food here and would not plan to go back.
Very good cold noodles. Quick service.
Great hole-in-the-wall resto. Great value for money. I requested for steamed dumplings, and they happily obliged
Awesome.
A staple of Charlottesville. The staff is always eager to help and more than friendly. The food is some of the most consistent across the city. As well as an awesome location.
Friendly, small place with limited but yummy dishes. I’m disappointed that they serve their food even when dining in, in styrofoam and with plastic utensils. :-/
Awesome. Just awesome. Cute little place on the downtown mall with a short & sweet menu of yummy things. Hot and sour soup to kinda die for! Awesome.
Like the dumplings
Good food, fast friendly service and reasonable prices. The Sesame Noodles in peanut sauce were terrific. Will definitely be eating there when we are on town.
Gosh darn I love this place.  The dumplings are simple but delicious.  Do not skimp on the sauce.  And if you want a treat try the pork hot bun.
I stopped for a quick lunch while shopping on the Downtown Mall.  Those were some tasty dumplings!
We love Marco & Luca’s dumplings! Great spot to stop in on your way to the movies or on game day...or any day!
So good... I always get sweet sour spicy noodles and two orders of dumplings
Big yummy dumplings
We found a good review of the shop online and decided to try it out for ourselves. Nice location and some great food. Limited menu and seating is minimal.
extremely fast service and consistent food. love the noodles they have! And cute atmosphere.
Best place for dumplings in Charlottesville. They’re delicious. Also recommend the sesame noodles
When you have 4 things on the menu it's going to good. I could eat 4 or 5 orders of the fried dumplings!!
Inexpensive and very tasty. A bit difficult to find, and parking can be difficult, but worth the stop. The steamed buns are better than the dumplings, but both are quite good. Quick service too.
Marco and Luca gets five stars from me. The food isn't amazing BUT you can get an order of dumplings in a matter of minutes for less than 5$ on the downtown mall which is pretty awesome.
Amazing sesame noodles and great dumplings
Best dumplings on Planet Earth. My husband drinks the sauce. OMG so yummy. No lie.

Dumplings are pretty delicious though they are about the only thing worth going for. Was also a little disappointed that the price I was charged for the chicken curry wasn't what was posted on the menu.

Great noodles and delicious dumplings! We were amazed at the tasty food and we tasted everything!  The crepe type meal was flavorful and filling. The dumplings were delicious!  Pleasant atmosphere and friendly staff. What’s not to like? Oh, the homeless man who wandered in. We just felt sorry for him.
Passable, a bit bland but seems to be tuned to local tastes.
Great Dumplings. Would recommend if you are in the area and need a little comfort food. Cheap and fast and nice for a little snack.
So bomb as always
Tastiest dumplings in cville. You should probably just get two orders and a site of their peanut sauce pasta. Delicious and reasonable
Very good food made fresh, daily
Hot and sour soup and hot and spicy noodles. Consistently good !
Always delicious, efficient and affordable place to eat!
This is a Charlottesville class. If you are visiting, you gotta try the dumplings.
Dumplings are second to nun the best
Clean, fast, inexpensive, and delicious! Vegan options available.

My boyfriend and I tried this place out for the first time. It was absolutely delicious. I got the large wonton soup and he got the 15 dollar combo that came with chicken curry, rice, a bao bun, and fried dumplings plus a drink! Seriously such a good deal and not only was it a good deal it was delicious. Wonton soup broth was so rich and flavorful. Would definitely recommend trying this place out.

Holy smokes this place is delicious. We are in town on Vacation & stopped in for a quick lunch. The staff is friendly & extremely accommodating. Add to this the food is flavorful & clean. Not greasy or heavy.

Had to call the urgent care before we could order dinner. We did it from the outdoor seating area, and instead of being shooed away for loitering, we were greeted at the front door with cold water.

I asked for lots of extra bok choy in my wonton soup, and they delivered big time! I almost chose a different place because I felt like I don’t usually get enough veggies at Marco and Luca, but I’m so glad they have this option now! The bok choy was tender and succulent. The handcrafted chicken broth was amazing—I could really taste the ginger, cilantro, green onions, lime, etc—and the wontons were silky smooth while holding their shape. This is prolly gonna be my new after-workout go to.

The sesame balls were fantastic as usual—such an amazing chewy/crispy texture with the perfect light, nutty sweetness—and my friend said the chicken curry combo was amazing too.
